description: This file defines the CustomerController class within the OrangeHRM Time Plugin, responsible for handling customer-related UI components, particularly preparing a customer list component with unselectable customer IDs during rendering.

classes.name: CustomerController
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer-related views within the OrangeHRM Time plugin, extending a Vue.js interface for UI component rendering, and utilizing customer service traits.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Pre-render hook that initializes a customer list component with unselectable customer IDs retrieved from the customer service.
